issuer_name: Greenland Mines Ltd (formerly Klotho Neurosciences, Inc.)

website.error: Company recently renamed to Greenland Mines Ltd (March 2026); pivoting to mining. No active drug-developer pipeline page.

ctgov.note: No interventional P1-3 trials sponsored by Klotho Neurosciences or Greenland Mines

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Greenland Mines Ltd (formerly Klotho Neurosciences) discloses in its 10-K (filed 2026-04-01) that 'We have not yet submitted any IND applications in connection with any gene therapies.' Its lead s-KL (alpha-Klotho) AAV gene therapy program for ALS and neurodegenerative disease remains preclinical. The company also holds five market-approved anti-cancer generic drugs (FOLFOX/FOLFIRI components) marketed in Germany and two off-patent biosimilar antibodies licensed from Reliance Life Sciences — these are already marketed/biosimilar generics, not active clinical pipeline assets. In March 2026 the company acquired Greenland Mines Corp., expanding into critical minerals mining and effectively pivoting away from drug development.

products: Four FOLFOX/FOLFIRI regimen components for metastatic colorectal/gastric cancer
